policy.native_scope: Direct TCP proxy flows to the remote userspace peer's own IPv4 address. The local node initiates the carrier.

measurement_scope: Throughput excludes SOCKS and carrier admission setup.
Short-flow completion includes SOCKS admission and application delivery.
Daemon CPU includes user and system CPU from both LowTier processes.
CPU excludes generators, destination service, relay, and unrelated kernel work.
Server CPU covers the control interval, including unloaded probes.
Client CPU starts immediately before bulk transfer.
RSS records samples every 100 ms and does not prove allocation peaks.
QUIC counters are latest periodic connection totals and include probes.
QUIC lost bytes are not retransmitted stream bytes.
Loss cohorts use the same userspace relay and remain separate from direct cohorts.
WSS uses its default single TCP lane.
